meta.parties: Munasinghe Et Al. v. The Assistant Government Agent, Puttalam

rules.statement: The Crown is estopped from challenging a surveyor's return if it has called upon the plaintiff to pay value for certain lots in accordance with that return.
rules.supporting_quote: "he defendant had by his declarations and acts caused or permitted him to believe. Again, although the evidence is slender on the -point, a portion of the land in question, about 15 acres, has been cleared. This evidence certainly comes from the defendant's side, and I cannot well see how it can be said there is nothing to show that the clearing was the work of the plaintiff"
